skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Witness to Glory
skins.content: Persona 3 Reload Collaboration Outfit/Witness to Glory. The costume Makoto Yuki wore performing at the school drama festival. The executioner who refused judgment walks out of the hall, and what awaits him is freedom and true glory.
skins.usage: The costume Makoto Yuki wore in the play.
skins.quote: True glory needs no looking up to—the generous, impartial sun scatters it over every one of us.
